definitions.gloss: healthy, robust, sound, in good health
definitions.explanation: Describes being in good physical health and vigor. Often used formally, especially in greetings or to describe elderly people who are still healthy.

examples.japanese: ご{壮健|そうけん}で{何|なに}よりです
examples.english: I'm glad to see you in good health

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は90{歳|さい}になっても{壮健|そうけん}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is still robust at 90 years old.

examples.japanese: {皆様|みなさま}のご{壮健|そうけん}とご{多幸|たこう}をお{祈|いの}りします。
examples.english: I wish everyone good health and happiness.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {壮健|そうけん}な{体|からだ}.

FORMAL USAGE: {壮健|そうけん} is often used in formal contexts, especially in greetings (ご{壮健|そうけん}で), letters, and formal speeches. It's particularly appropriate when inquiring about or commenting on the health of elderly or respected persons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{壮健|そうけん}で (I hope you're well - greeting)
- {壮健|そうけん}な{体|からだ} (healthy body)
- ご{壮健|そうけん}をお{祈|いの}りする (to wish someone good health)

RELATED WORDS:
- {健康|けんこう} (healthy - more common)
- {元気|げんき} (healthy, energetic - casual)
- {頑健|がんけん} (sturdy, robust)
- {矍鑠|かくしゃく} (hale and hearty - for elderly)
